_comment: Documented intentional divergences subtracted from the Layer 0 diff buckets. `exports.missing` keys are upstream symbols knowingly absent from PSFlow's surface; `exports.extra` keys are PSFlow-only names that are intentional renames/idioms. Each value is the rationale shown in report.md. Genuine-but-tracked gaps reference a ticket. A NEW upstream symbol not listed here trips the parity gate.

missing.NodeAddChange: Constructor of the PS `NodeChange` sum type, reachable via `NodeChange(..)`. TS exports each change as a standalone type; PS models them as one sum type (intentional).
